# Gaura Construction (Pvt) Ltd

> Gaura Construction (Pvt) Ltd is a Sri Lankan construction company delivering civil
> construction, house building, renovations, interior design, MEP services, steel building
> construction and complete design-and-build projects across all 25 districts of Sri Lanka.
> The company reports 10+ years of operating experience, 235+ staff, and 75+ completed projects.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Gaura Construction (Pvt) Ltd
- Sector: General contracting / building construction (Sri Lanka)
- Registered offices:
  - Narammala (head office): 02 UB Wijekoon St, Narammala, North Western Province, Sri Lanka
  - Colombo: 101 Horton Pl, Colombo 00700, Western Province, Sri Lanka
- Service area: all 25 districts of Sri Lanka (site work delivered island-wide from the two offices above)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +94 71 372 0667
- Email: info@gauraconstruction.lk
- Website: https://www.gauraconstruction.lk
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gauraconstruction
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gaura-construction-sri-lanka

Named engineering staff published on the site:
- Vihanga Vijantha Weerasingha — BSc (Hons) Project Management; HND Civil Engineering and Built Environment
- Nilitha Bandara Weerasooriya — BSc (Hons) Surveying Sciences, RICS accredited (Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka)
- Buddhika S Weerasekara — BEng (Hons) Civil and Construction Engineering

## Services

- [Civil Constructions](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/civil-constructions-sri-lanka): structural and infrastructure works.
- [House Construction](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/house-construction-sri-lanka): residential building, budget through premium tiers.
- [Renovations](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/renovations-sri-lanka): home, office and commercial renovation.
- [Interior Design](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/interior-design-sri-lanka): interiors and fitouts.
- [MEP Services](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/mep-services-sri-lanka): mechanical, electrical and plumbing.
- [Steel Building Construction](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/steel-building-construction-sri-lanka): steel-frame warehouses, factories and commercial buildings.
- [Cabana Construction](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/cabana-construction-sri-lanka): cabanas and outdoor structures for hotels and resorts.
- [All services](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/services)

## Reference content

These pages answer specific factual questions and carry the underlying figures and methodology.

- [House construction cost per square foot in Sri Lanka (2026)](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-house-construction-cost-sri-lanka): per-square-foot ranges by build tier (Budget, Standard, Semi-Luxury, Luxury, Premium).
- [Construction cost calculator](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/construction-cost-calculator): interactive per-square-foot estimator using the tiers above.
- [How long it takes to build a house in Sri Lanka](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-house-construction-timeline-sri-lanka): stage-by-stage schedule from approvals to handover.
- [Construction contracts in Sri Lanka](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-construction-contract-guide-sri-lanka): scope, BOQ, payment stages, penalties, warranty.
- [Construction loans in Sri Lanka](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-construction-loan-guide-sri-lanka): bank requirements and disbursement stages.
- [Soil test and land survey](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-soil-test-land-survey-sri-lanka): what each assessment covers and why it precedes design.
- [Steel vs reinforced concrete](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-steel-vs-concrete-construction-sri-lanka): cost, speed and durability trade-offs.
- [MEP services explained](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-mep-services-explained-sri-lanka): scope of mechanical, electrical and plumbing work.
- [Construction quality checklist](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-construction-quality-checklist-sri-lanka): what to inspect at each build stage.
- [Choosing a construction company in Sri Lanka](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog-best-construction-company-in-sri-lanka): CIDA registration, portfolio, in-house teams, pricing, warranty.
- [All guides](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/blog)

## District coverage

Gaura Construction serves all 25 districts. Each district has a page describing local coverage,
the towns served, and district-relevant cost guidance — for example
[Colombo](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/best-construction-company-colombo),
[Gampaha](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/best-construction-company-gampaha),
[Kandy](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/best-construction-company-kandy),
[Kurunegala](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/best-construction-company-kurunegala),
[Galle](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/best-construction-company-galle),
[Jaffna](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/best-construction-company-jaffna).
The [HTML sitemap](https://www.gauraconstruction.lk/html-sitemap) lists all 25.

Note on locations: the company operates from the two offices listed above and serves the other
districts from them. District pages describe service coverage, not additional physical premises.

## Languages

Customer service is available in English and Sinhala (සිංහල). District pages carry Sinhala-language
FAQ entries covering services, coverage and contact details.
